name: Nagumo Itsuki
source:
A third year student and Misaki's older brother. He is the student council president. He often skips his student council president's duties. Every time he does he gets in a quarrel with the vice president, Kyouka, and Shinichi has to calm the two of them down. He is overprotective of Misaki and is always worried about her.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
